Missed reads → billing system substitutes estimated reads (process step 'estimate substitution when no accepted read')

Incorrect bills → customers file dispute tickets
Increased dispute tickets volume (doubled since August) (E-03)

remedies.description: Increase field reader headcount by three FTEs to address the staffing shortage reported by SH‑FIELD (E‑05), thereby raising route completion toward the target of 0.95 (E‑04).
remedies.feasibility_rationale: Hiring and training exceed the remaining 225‑minute contest window.
remedies.residual_gap: If hired, route completion may still fall short if other issues persist; gap remains until headcount is fully onboarded and routes adjusted.

remedies.description: Optimize manual‑read route sequencing and push priority updates (push_route_update) to achieve ≥0.95 completion without adding staff, using existing route‑log data (E‑04) and confirming changes with Field Operations Manager as required by K‑DISPATCH (E‑08).
remedies.feasibility_rationale: Analysis and scheduling can be completed within the remaining 225 minutes; runtime confirmation is permitted.
remedies.residual_gap: Residual gap depends on whether optimized routes can overcome the three‑reader shortfall; if not, some missed reads may persist.

remedies.description: Enhance AMI‑to‑billing handoff reliability and monitor AMI read quality to reduce reliance on manual reads, addressing the unknown U‑U1 about AMI read errors contributing to wrong bills (U‑U1, E‑02).
remedies.feasibility_rationale: Monitoring and vendor coordination can be initiated within the time window; no constraints prohibit these actions.
remedies.residual_gap: Even with perfect AMI reads, manual reads for non‑AMI meters would still be needed; gap remains for those segments.
